evidenceRead: all open issue bodies, labels, authors, createdAt, updatedAt, and comments
linked pull-request state, merge SHA, checks, and stated boundaries
latest published release target and release notes

triagePolicy.missingInformationClosure: Only eligible after a concrete maintainer information request remains unanswered for the project's waiting period. An old date, an incomplete report, or needs-triage alone is not evidence of an unanswered request.
triagePolicy.completed: Use only where the scoped work is demonstrably merged; distinguish released fixes from code-only fixes in the closure note.
triagePolicy.notPlanned: Use for an explicit product decision not to implement, or when a precisely linked canonical tracker retains every still-wanted requirement. Do not use it merely to reduce the open count.
triagePolicy.duplicate: No current open issue is safe to close as duplicate without first naming a canonical tracker that retains its uncovered scope.
